entities.name: Jan Krzysztof Zawisza Dowgiałło
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jan Karol Dowgiałło Zawisza was a Polish clergyman and bishop for the Roman Catholic Diocese of Vilnius. He became ordained in 1657. He was appointed bishop in 1656. He died on 9 March 1661.
